body.statement: For any \(e_0\in\mathcal W\), the nominal lower endpoint \(a_{e_0}=\ell_{e_0}\) is attained in \(\mathcal A_{\mathrm{cyc}}(\mu)\) if and only if the interval-tension system obtained by replacing \([\ell_{e_0},u_{e_0}]\) with \([\ell_{e_0},\ell_{e_0}]\) contains a vertex potential. This holds if and only if its two-arc difference-constraint digraph has no negative directed cycle. The analogous equivalence with \([u_{e_0},u_{e_0}]\) characterizes upper-endpoint attainment; applying the same test to the augmented edge multiset \(\mathcal E\sqcup\mathcal K\) characterizes endpoint exactness in \(\mathcal A_Y(\mu)\).
body.justification: Coordinatewise sharpness can fail even when the joint fiber is nonempty, so the endpoint certificate prevents reporting unattainable box extremes.
body.gap: Fenaroli2026 derives closed-form cohortwise endpoints under never-treated comparison groups. No adjacent anticipation paper provides a necessary-and-sufficient negative-cycle certificate after a comparison cohort is reused across risk sets.
body.consumer: Sensitivity tables for the Indonesian anti-cheating rollout can flag which nominal cohort-year anticipation bounds are actually reachable under all shared comparisons.
